ai.summary: The home page at https://www.charitywater.org/ loaded in the headless browser with HTTP 200 and HTTPS. FundraiseUp installation code was not found in the page source, and no FundraiseUp widget request or global object was recorded. The page load event took 9.0 s, which is above the 6 s target. Google Tag Manager (GTM-P6DJRR), GA4 (G-SKG6MDYX1T) and CookieScript were found. Meta Pixel was not seen, which is optional. The /donate page returned HTTP 200 but no form, checkout link or install code was found in the HTML without JavaScript. The browser did not click any buttons, so checkout behavior was not tested. Overall status is not installed because the installation code is missing.

customer_email.subject: Next steps to finish your donation page setup
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thank you for working with us on your online donation setup. We checked your website, and the donation platform code is not on the home page yet.

Please make these changes:

1. Add the donation platform installation code to the head section of your home page. We will send you the exact code.
2. Check that your /donate page includes a visible donation form or donation link in its HTML, so it works without JavaScript.
3. Reduce the home page load time to under 6 seconds. It currently takes about 9 seconds.

Please let us know when the code is live. We will run the check again after that.

Thank you,
Onboarding Team
